decisions.reason: The online customer portal is a visible digital investment tied to the announced direction of deeper customer collaboration, so writing it off after one year would expose the decision without results clearly demanding it.
The packaging display won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, a strong public commitment and success signal that makes dropping it very unlikely.

The quarter-pallet pegboard display sits close to the core offer and has its own page, so it is cheap to keep and supports the broader 3D cardboard portfolio, though such catalog items can be quietly rotated out as Product A was.
The small counter display is a low-cost extension of the established display business with a dedicated page and no evidence of failure, so management keeps it.
The large freestanding information display fits the display-only focus and is visibly presented, so it is likely retained, though low investment makes later quiet removal possible.
